_doc: Maid Marian turns up on ordinary jobs once she has met the band (the marian_page legend), except while she is locked in the tower. chance: how often a new robbery or rescue has her; help_chance: how often she makes it easier (help_chance_wed after the wedding). After the wedding she lives at Major Oak Camp: visits use text_home, and "home" says what she does for the band when it rests there.

home.text: Marian keeps watch over the camp while the band rests. Sir Guy's scouts slink away, and his raid is set back.

warning.text_home: Marian has been out in the forest at dawn, reading tracks. She knows exactly where the Sheriff's men have laid their traps.
warning.text: Maid Marian slips out of the castle with a warning: she knows exactly where the Sheriff's traps are laid.

distraction.text_home: Marian rides ahead dressed as a lost lady and asks a guard the way to Nottingham... a very long way round. One less guard to fight!
distraction.text: Maid Marian drops her glove in front of a guard and asks him to fetch it... all the way back to the castle. One less guard to fight!

bandages.text_home: Marian comes from the camp with a basket of bread, honey and clean bandages. Everyone feels much better.
bandages.text: Maid Marian meets the band with a basket of bread, honey and clean bandages. Everyone feels much better.

fat_purse.text_home: Marian's old maid at the castle sent word to the camp: this purse is far fatter than it looks!
fat_purse.text: Maid Marian heard the Sheriff's steward boasting: this purse is far fatter than it looks!

followed.text_home: Marian rides into the village to buy thread, and one of Sir Guy's knights knows her face. He follows her right to the band!
followed.text: Maid Marian rides out to warn the band, but Sir Guy's men have followed her! A knight comes crashing through the trees.

spotted.text_home: Marian's scarlet cloak is easy to spot from the road. A crossbowman sees her, and calls his friends.
spotted.text: Maid Marian waves to the band from the road. A crossbowman on the wall sees her, and calls his friends.

escort.text_home: Marian insists on coming along from the camp to see the poor get their share. With a lady to guard, the band must fight extra carefully, and the Sheriff has doubled the guard.
escort.text: Maid Marian insists on coming along to see the poor get their share. With a lady to guard, the band must fight extra carefully, and the Sheriff has doubled the guard.
